issues.issue: The 'existingTestsAtRisk' analysis is wrong for P3. PackedCorrelatedMinusAlternativeTest#typedSemiAntiAlternativesSupportComposedLocalRightHandSides (core/queryalgebra/evaluation/src/test/java/.../packed/PackedCorrelatedMinusAlternativeTest.java:225-240) is not only a Union body: its rightHandSides list contains `new Difference(probe(values, "entity"), patientProbe(values))` and patientProbe (:~470-473) is `?patient urn:hasMedication ?entity`, i.e. the nested DIFFERENCE's right child references the shared name ?entity. P3 (`intersects(shared, relationReferencedNames(rightChild)) -> decline`) therefore declines it and the assertion `assertEquals(3, typedSemiAntiAlternativeCount(encodeForPlanning(minus)))` for the MINUS variant fails. In addition, P3's stated justification ('StatementPattern evaluation does not bind valued Vars, so the substituted constant leaves the inner compatibility domain') is not what the code does: BindingAssignerOptimizer.VarVisitor (core/queryalgebra/evaluation/src/main/java/.../optimizer/BindingAssignerOptimizer.java:47-53) builds `Var.of(name, value, isAnonymous, isConstant)` keeping isConstant=false for user vars; StatementPattern.getBindingNames() (core/queryalgebra/model/.../StatementPattern.java:146-158) returns all four var names regardless of value; StatementPatternQueryEvaluationStep's unbound test (:243-290, :493) keys on isConstant(), not hasValue(); and MinusQueryEvaluationStep.actualOutputBindingNames (:136) derives the comparison domain from getBindingNames(). Moreover FilterIterator.evaluateSubstitutedExists (:361-370) passes the full outer row as `bindings` into the substituted body. So the substituted inner MINUS very likely still compares on ?entity and the nested-DIFFERENCE case may be substitution-equivalent, making P3 an unnecessary decline.
issues.suggestion: Before landing P3, add a differential unit test for `VALUES ?entity {..} MINUS { ?entity :dosage ?dose MINUS { ?patient :hasMedication ?entity } }` (planned vs StrictEvaluationStrategy oracle) under a cost model that selects the anti-join; if it agrees, drop P3 (and the INTERSECTION half, whose IntersectIteration compares whole binding sets symmetrically) and keep only P2; if it disagrees, keep P3 and update typedSemiAntiAlternativesSupportComposedLocalRightHandSides to expect the Difference RHS to be declined for MINUS while remaining accepted for the pure NOT EXISTS variant.

issues.issue: P2 (`referenced(R) ∩ pv(L) ⊆ shared`) is only sufficient if the derived FILTER(NOT EXISTS R, L) is evaluated over rows that bind at most pv(L). The executor does not guarantee that: FilterIterator (:354-370) calls `arg.evaluate(bindings)` and `evaluateSubstitutedExists(..., bindings)` with whatever incoming row the enclosing operator passes, and the enclosing JOIN only protects a Difference child from binding push-in (raw notes: 'isOutOfScope now includes containsDifferenceInCurrentScope -> contract hash join'); a FILTER alternative in the Difference's memo group is not a Difference, so for `?y :s ?x . { ?x :p ?n MINUS { ?x :q ?m FILTER(?m = ?y) } }` a nested-loop join can hand {y,x} to the derived filter, the probe substitutes ?y, and rows MINUS keeps are removed. ?y ∉ pv(L) so P2 passes. I verified the planner-side hoists are blocked (addSafeChildFilterJoinAlternative PackedLogicalRuleProgram.java:~300-320 returns on scalarHasEmbeddedRelationOrTerm; alias commutation :146-165 likewise; optimizeRelocatableFilterRegion uses relOutputMaskId(inputRelationId) PackedJoinEnumerator.java:2551), but PackedJoinEnumerator.inheritedPrefixSafe (:2362-2381) admits FILTER relations under contextual unary operators and the physical join contract is decided outside PLRP, so the guard's precondition is not established by the design.
issues.suggestion: Widen P2 to `referenced(R) ∩ (symbols occurring anywhere in the query outside R) ⊆ shared` (equivalently: every name R references is either R-local or shared); this is cheap (one pass over the root) and makes the alternative independent of which row the executor feeds it. Add the differential test above (LMDB and evaluation module, with the join order forced by costs) to the repro set.

issues.issue: The claim 'nothing sound is lost' is overstated. deriveGroupFacts (PackedQueryCodec.java:400-421) derives FILTER groups only via copyAll(child) (:414-415); today the finite narrowing of a FILTER group comes exclusively from the sound FINITE_FILTER_VALUES alternative JOIN(VALUES, input) (addFiniteFilterAlternative :1906-1917, guarded by finiteDomainTermIdentitySafe :3254-3264). With seed-only derivation, `?s :p ?o FILTER(?o IN ("a","b")) . ?t :q ?o` no longer proves the enclosing JOIN empty when :q's stored range excludes those strings (deriveJoinFacts intersect :427-446, addEmptyDomainJoinAlternative :2049-2062), and the join loses the finite domain for costing.
issues.suggestion: Alongside the seed-only policy, add a seed-side deriveFilterFacts in the codec that intersects the child fact with the filter's finite constants when collectFiniteDomain + finiteDomainTermIdentitySafe hold (reuse PLRP's predicates via the existing assuresSymbol/outputsSymbol bridge). Re-run PackedPredicateRangePlanningTest#disconnectedJoinCommutationRetainsEmptyProofInEveryEquivalentGroup (:521, asserts 2 PREDICATE_RANGE_EMPTY groups) and #lateAliasCommutationReactivatesRangeFactsBeforeHypergraphConstruction (:131) and record whether either proof depended on an alternative-derived fact.

issues.issue: Fix step (5) changes the interning key of IN/COMPARE_ANY/COMPARE_ALL scalars (semanticScope slot, PackedQueryCodec.java:1379-1385 currently passes 0) and step (3) changes the key of every planner-derived EXISTS (existsScalar :1685-1701). Because the codec's EXISTS key already uses `nameSetPayload(VarNameCollector.process(subQuery))` (:1243-1247), a derived EXISTS whose structural referenced set equals the user's set will now collide with a user-written `FILTER NOT EXISTS {R}` over the same L elsewhere in the query; internLogicalIfSameGroup (PackedExpressionInterner.java:79-85, REJECT_CROSS_GROUP) then returns 0 and the MINUS alternative is silently not generated (lost optimization, not unsound). Also the fallback in step (2) must keep the `payloads.operatorTag(subqueryPayloadId) == SUBQUERY_VALUE` check that :3628 has today.
issues.suggestion: Accept the collision as benign but document it, or keep the derived EXISTS distinguishable via a scalar flag rather than the name set. Keep the SUBQUERY_VALUE guard. Note for wp3: both key changes must bump whatever version participates in PackedQueryCacheIdentity.

issues.issue: The design says 'the hint may only be attached when it passes' but does not state the invariant that keeps it true under metadata propagation: PackedNodeMetadataArena.copy (:248-255) ORs semanticFlags into every target of addAlternative/addCanonical/canonicalRelation, and addAdjacentFilterCommutationAlternative (PackedLogicalRuleProgram.java:~510-540) explicitly re-attaches SEMANTIC_ASSURED_SHARED_MINUS_FILTER to both commuted filters. I verified these paths keep P1-P5 valid (the commuted inner filter has the same outputs/assured set as FILTER(cond, base); pruneUnusedOptionals walks group seeds only, so it never rebuilds the alternative), but the planner half of 3.4.4 must list the commuted FILTERs as hinted bodies too, and PackedFilterRules' helper logicals (memo.addCanonicalLogical, PackedFilterRules.java:~105) carry no flag and fall back to SEMI_ANTI_NOT_EXISTS in PackedJoinEnumerator.scheduledFilterSemanticKind (:7822-7841) — equivalent under P1-P5 but worth a comment.
issues.suggestion: Add a unit test that scans every FILTER relation carrying SEMANTIC_ASSURED_SHARED_MINUS_FILTER after encodeForPlanning and re-checks P1-P2 against its own input; extend the 3.4.4 answer to include the FILTER_COMMUTATION-derived filters.

issues.issue: Line references drift: widen's kind/language ORs are PackedDomainFacts.java:197-198 (not 189-190), universal AND is :199, intersect kinds at :161-165 and language at :168; intersect's universalBits is OR (:169), which is correct and should be listed among the audited fields. The open question about datatypeOnlyProvider is resolved by the code: its second argument is universalBits and it sets LANGUAGE_WITHOUT explicitly (PackedPredicateRangePlanningTest.java datatypeOnlyProvider body), so the languageAbsent* tests do not encode the bug. Also the LMDB provider itself emits kinds=LITERAL with languageBits=0 when the RdfTermDomain has neither language fact (LmdbPackedPredicateRangeProvider.java:57-64), so provider-vs-provider widening was already unsound, not only VALUES-vs-provider.
issues.suggestion: Fix the line numbers in the PR text, drop the datatypeOnlyProvider open question, and add a PackedDomainFactsTest case widen(LITERAL/WITHOUT, LITERAL/0) -> language 0 to cover the provider-side witness.

issues.issue: Open question resolved: strict and lenient EQ do differ. QueryEvaluationUtility.getCommonDatatype (core/queryalgebra/evaluation/.../util/QueryEvaluationUtility.java:340-343) admits cross-calendar comparison only when !strict, and handleCommonDatatype (:259) admits durations only when !strict, so FILTER(?o = "2020-01-01T00:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime) over a finite xsd:date domain returns incompatible in strict mode and a definite result in lenient mode. The 'refuse when modes disagree' branch is required, not a defensive assert. Also the new 'all comparisons definite -> 0 added -> EmptySet' path is a stronger proof than today's `count == expandedCount ? -1` (:2760) and inherits the finite-fact completeness exposure that wp3 tracks (uncommitted/committed drift).
issues.suggestion: Keep the refuse branch; add a unit test with a dateTime constant against a finite date domain asserting no anchor and no EmptySet; mention in the wp3 touchpoint that PREDICATE_RANGE_EMPTY now also arises from the finite fallback.

issues.issue: Guard placement detail: analyzeCodeTypeBranch collects values for branch 0 at offset 0 and branch 1 at offset MAX_FINITE_VALUES (appendBranchCodeValue :967-983), and codeComparison (:922-949) accepts `?c = ?t` (two variables) plus one literal, so the collected set is the VALUES rows plus the literal. If the guard is put in compatibleCodeTypeBranches (:832-841) it must iterate both offsets; putting it inside appendBranchCodeValue (reject non-term-safe values as they arrive) is simpler and covers both.
issues.suggestion: Implement the guard in appendBranchCodeValue via a static termIdentitySafe(Value) shared with finiteDomainTermIdentitySafe.

missedFindings: LmdbPackedPredicateRangeProvider.java:57-64 emits languageBits=0 for literal domains lacking both language facts, so PackedDomainFacts.widen (:198) was already unsound between two provider ranges (not only VALUES vs provider); the 3.2.3 lattice fix covers it but the design's root-cause text and tests only mention VALUES seeding.

The planner half of 3.4.4 omits the FILTER_COMMUTATION-derived filters: addAdjacentFilterCommutationAlternative (PackedLogicalRuleProgram.java:~510-540) copies SEMANTIC_ASSURED_SHARED_MINUS_FILTER onto both commuted FILTERs, and copyRelation (PackedNodeMetadataArena.java:248-255) ORs semantic flags on every addAlternative/addCanonical target; the answer to 'which bodies may carry the hint' must include these derived filters and state the invariant that keeps them equivalent.

Executor row provenance for the derived FILTER: the design assumes the alternative is evaluated over rows binding only pv(L); FilterIterator (:354-370) evaluates with the incoming row and the JOIN-side Difference protection (containsDifferenceInCurrentScope) does not apply to a FILTER alternative. P2 must be widened or the test `?y :s ?x . { ?x :p ?n MINUS { ?x :q ?m FILTER(?m = ?y) } }` added.
semanticRegressionRisks: 3.2.1 P3: `VALUES ?entity {:e1} MINUS { ?entity :dosage ?dose MINUS { ?patient :hasMedication ?entity } }` (data: e1 :dosage 1; p1 :hasMedication e1) — P3 declines a body that is plausibly substitution-equivalent (substituted ?entity keeps isConstant=false and stays in getBindingNames/comparison domain), losing the anti-join and breaking PackedCorrelatedMinusAlternativeTest#typedSemiAntiAlternativesSupportComposedLocalRightHandSides (:225-240).

3.2.1 P2 too narrow: `?y :s ?x . { ?x :p ?n MINUS { ?x :q ?m FILTER(?m = ?y) } }` with :a :p 1; :a :q 1; :z :s :a — SPARQL keeps a/1 (R evaluated standalone, ?y unbound -> filter error -> R empty); the derived FILTER passes P2 (?y ∉ pv(L)) and, if the enclosing join hands {y,x} to it, the substituted probe finds a row and removes a/1.
3.2.1 P4 (conservative): every MINUS body containing a sub-SELECT loses the anti-join even when the projection is transparent (documented by the design; acceptable until wp4 lands).

3.2.4c: `?s :p ?o FILTER(?o IN ("a","b")) . ?t :q ?o` with :q's stored range disjoint from {"a","b"} — today the enclosing JOIN can be proved empty through the FILTER group's alternative-derived finite fact; seed-only derivation loses that sound proof unless a seed-side filter-fact derivation is added.

3.2.2 step (3): planner-derived NOT EXISTS now waits for every referenced outer binding within L's region (PackedFilterRules.java:60-90 guardedCorrelatedPredicate uses the embedded mask ∩ outer outputs), which can move the anti-probe later in the region than today; no correctness regression, cost only (PackedSearchTest#correlatedNotExists* at :2357/:2457/:3096 may need re-baselining).

3.2.4a: `?s :v ?o FILTER(?o = 3)` over a finite stored domain {1, "01", 1.0, 2} now yields EmptySet where today the expansion is refused (-1); sound only while the finite fact is complete for the execution snapshot — same exposure as existing PREDICATE_RANGE_EMPTY proofs (wp3).

3.2.3 fix (3): VALUES {1} joined with `?s :p ?o` whose range is xsd:int gives datatypes 1<<integer & 1<<int = 0 -> unknown (not EMPTY) via mergeDatatypesIntersect (:228-238); no wrong result, but do not 'improve' this to EMPTY without term-identity reasoning.
verifiedClaims: 3.2.2 root cause: addScalarDependencies (PackedLogicalRuleProgram.java:3607-3631) calls addRelationOutputs(subquery) for EXISTS/IN/ANY/ALL and ignores scalars.semanticScopeId; the codec records VarNameCollector names there for EXISTS only (PackedQueryCodec.java:1243-1247) and compareSubqueryScalar passes 0 (:1379-1385); addCommutableScalarDependencies (:580-583) already consumes the slot; existsScalar(int) passes 0 (:1685-1687).

3.2.2 consumers: pruneUnusedOptionals FILTER branch (:3066-3071) and LEFT_JOIN branch (:3119-3128, observedRightBindings = rightOutputs ∩ live, relationAssuresAll(left) -> optionalRemoved); addUnusedOptionalAlternative (:2959-2989) emits for DISTINCT/REDUCED/GROUP; addProjectionBelowOrderAlternative (:1868-1889) uses addScalarDependencies for ORDER keys and containsAll(projectedOutputs, deps).

3.2.2 masking step (4) is sound: names not in relationOutputs(orderInput) are unbound in both the original and rewritten evaluation; `live` in pruneUnusedOptionals is only ever intersected with rightOutputs (:3121-3123).
VarNameCollector.meet(Var) (core/queryalgebra/model/.../collectors/VarNameCollector.java:65-69) excludes valued vars, matching codec term() (:1393-1406) interning symbols only for !hasValue.

PackedBindingFacts.deriveScalarSchedulingFacts (:163-192) reads scalarSemanticScope only for EXISTS; deriveRelationOutputs (:236-243) and deriveRelationAssuredBindings (:284-292) use the first group member only.

3.2.1 root cause: addCorrelatedMinusAlternative (:381-421) computes shared = outputs(L) ∩ outputs(R) (:384-385), guards only assurance + safeCorrelatedMinusProbe (:386-389), records nameSetPayload(sharedNames) on the EXISTS (:393), attaches SEMANTIC_ASSURED_SHARED_MINUS_FILTER (:406-407) and typed SEMI_ANTI_MINUS_ASSURED_SHARED anti-joins (:408-415); safeCorrelatedMinusProbe (:604-627) admits FILTER/EXTENSION/PROJECTION/LEFT_JOIN/GROUP/DIFFERENCE bodies; PackedJoinEnumerator.scheduledFilterSemanticKind (:7822-7841) and PackedPlanMaterializer.semiAntiJoin (:252-274) turn the flag into the 'minus-assured-shared' hint; FilterIterator substitutes every bound name via BindingAssignerOptimizer.VarVisitor (:47-53).

All three MINUS emissions (plain FILTER alternative, typed anti-joins, semantic flag) are inside addCorrelatedMinusAlternative after the early return at :386-389, so a guard placed there covers them; addSemiAntiAlternatives (:423-466) only re-derives the minus kind from the flag already attached.

addSafeChildFilterJoinAlternative and addSafeAliasFilterCommutationAlternative both return early on scalarHasEmbeddedRelationOrTerm (EXISTS/IN/ANY/ALL), so the derived NOT EXISTS is never hoisted above an enclosing join by PLRP; PackedFilterRules pushdown (:60-90) requires the target side to assure embeddedRef ∩ outer outputs, which under P2 equals shared.

addSemiAntiAlternatives correlatedNames = outputs(L) ∩ outputs(R) (:456-457) as the design states; PackedCorrelatedMinusAlternativeTest#keepsLocallyScopedDerivedAntiProbeSchedulableWhenOuterBindingIsAssured (:261-275) has L = JOIN(VALUES ?entity, ?patient :hasMedication ?entity), R references {entity, dose} -> P2 holds; LmdbOptimizerPipelineTest#lmdbCascadesPushesFiniteMembershipBelowMinusBeforeMaterializedExists (:1071-1080) L outputs {requirement}, R references {requirement,test,measurement} -> P2 holds.

3.2.3 root cause: widen ORs kind and language bits (PackedDomainFacts.java:197-198) while treating datatypes 0 as unknown (:200-204), bounds/finite only when both present (:205-224); intersect treats kind AND == 0 as EMPTY (:161-165) and ANDs language (:168); seedBindingSetAssignmentFact (PackedQueryCodec.java:537-568) sets STATE_KNOWN, finite values and kinds only; langMatchesVerdict/languageVerdict/datatypeVerdict (:2215-2305) fire only on non-zero bits; verdicts route to EmptySet/filter-drop in addPredicateRangeFilterAlternatives (:1940-1956).

The intersect fix's 'WITH-only ∩ WITHOUT-only with kinds == LITERAL -> EMPTY' is sound because the verdict code treats a single language bit as a universal claim over all literals in the range (languageVerdict :2263-2273, langMatchesVerdict :2299-2303).
PackedPredicateRangePlanningTest.datatypeOnlyProvider(datatype, universalBits) sets LANGUAGE_WITHOUT explicitly; the languageAbsent* tests (:687-720) do not depend on 0 meaning WITHOUT.

3.2.4a root cause: expandAnchorValue finite fallback (:2748-2760) uses stored.equals(value); collectFiniteDomain (:3267-3290) accepts only EQUALITY_COMPARISON and LIST_MEMBER (no SAME_TERM), so value-equality expansion is the right semantics there; valuePossiblyEqualsRange (:2487-2526) uses finiteRangeContainsTerm only for IRIs/bnodes, so a non-canonical numeric constant reaches expandAnchorValue; the current `count == expandedCount ? -1` tail never emits EmptySet from this path; addRangeAnchorAlternative guards with containsBindingAssignmentFor (:2581, recursive over all children :3507-3517).
LmdbPackedPredicateRangeProvider emits finite domains when RdfTermDomain.isFinite() (:88-93), so 3.2.4a is reachable e2e.

3.2.4b root cause: addFiniteCodeTypeAlternative (:706-755) builds JOIN(JOIN(VALUES code, VALUES type), JOIN(?e a ?type, ?e :code ?c)) with no term-identity check; appendBranchCodeValue (:967-983) only checks instanceof Value; distinctCountName requires COUNT(?e) with no group keys, so ?t is unobservable; PackedRewriteBindingSafetyTest#finiteTypeDomainPreservesNumericValueEquality (:94-127) uses xsd:int on both sides (term-equal); PackedGroupGraphSafetyTest#finiteCodeTypePreservesGraphContexts uses string codes A/B/C (codeTypeBranch helper) so it is unaffected.

3.2.4c root cause: deriveFactsAndSaturateRules (PackedQueryCodec.java:376-395) calls deriveGroupFacts for every relation id; deriveGroupFacts writes into relations.groupId(relationId) (:400-421); PackedDomainFacts.put intersects an existing fact (:65-70); deriveJoinFacts intersects when both sides assure (:427-439); mergeFiniteValuesIntersect is by object id (:259-280); internCanonical uses size+1 as group id (PackedExpressionInterner.java:113-119) so groupId(id)==id identifies the seed; internLogicalIfSameGroup rejects cross-group (:79-85). Rule-created canonicalRelation groups (:1025-1031) are their own seeds and still get facts under the seed-only policy.

Red baseline: repro/f2/initial-evidence.review-f2.txt records LMDB 31 tests/8 failures and evaluation 13/6 with one failure name each (c3FilterOverWideJoin..., c4CodeTypeRewriteWithoutScopeFlags); per-method red status must be re-established. The evaluation repro harness (PackedRuleSemanticsReviewReproTest:365-388) compares PackedCascadesPlanner.optimize(root, goal, SUBJECT_LOOKUP_COSTS, provider) against StrictEvaluationStrategy on the unoptimized tree, and the LMDB harness (:456-479) compares first/second run against a StrictEvaluationStrategy oracle over the connection, so the listed repro methods do exercise the rules the design changes (MINUS rule via cost-forced anti-join, EXISTS liveness via DISTINCT/COUNT/ORDER observers, finite fallback via NON_CANONICAL_NUMERIC_PROVIDER with UNIVERSAL_NUMBER but no CANONICAL_INTEGER, code/type via cleared scope flags).
